ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Preparing Future Mathematicians. See http://www.math.uiuc.edu/timetable/ for the full course description. Restrited to graduate students in the Department of Mathematics. Prerequisite: permission of the instructor or Director of Graduate Studies. Students from the following programs must contact the Director of Graduate Studies in Mathematics <Laugesen@illinois.edu> to request permission to register for the course: MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC, MS:Statistics -UIUC, MS:Statistics -- Applied -UIUC, MS: Statistics: Analytics, or MS: Financial Engineering.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Tchg of Mathematics -UIUC, MS:Mathematics -UIUC, or PHD:Mathematics -UIUC.
